//: Standalone strict TypeScript config for the markdown-artifact extension repo. Extends nothing — the package compiles on its own (React toolchain scaffold; typecheck covers src + tests). No dist emit: the display entry is consumed as SOURCE by the host bundler, and `main`/`types` point at source.
//sanitizer: The SDK's markdown sanitizer leaf entry is HOST-PROVIDED: the host resolves it when it builds this display, and a standalone extension repository cannot resolve the SDK at all. The path below therefore resolves the specifier to the real SDK source when one is installed, and to the signature-only declaration in ./types when none is. The order matters: an installed SDK always wins, so this repository can never typecheck against a stale local shape.
